newsitem.title: USA: Favorable weather conditons in Brazil coffee belt.
newsitem.headline: Favorable weather conditons in Brazil coffee belt.

text.p: Near normal temperatures are expected in Brazil today, with some increasing clouds and scattered showers and thunderstorms developing, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Wednesday.

The latest indications are for favorable conditions for the trees and the maturing crops. Fair skies were observed this morning, with temperatures near normal with lows in the 50s (low to middle teens C).
The extended forecast calls for much colder air to develop over Argentina in the next few days and move into the coffee belt over the weekend.
However, no damaging cold is expected, WSC said.
WSC expects clouds to increase today with scattered showers and thunderstorms continuing into Thursday, with low temperatures in the 50s to low 60s F (low to middle teens C).

Fair to partly cloudy skies are expected for Friday and Saturday. Cooler weather in store for Friday and Saturday, with low in the 40s to low 50s (5-12 C). The coldest weather is expected in Northern Parana. ((--New York Commodity Desk, 212 859-1640))
